title: SAML 2.0: Metadata Authority Wizard and Validation Roundtrip
creator: Maya Singh
description: Build a robust SAML 2.0 setup wizard that performs a full metadata exchange and validation roundtrip for Redwood Private and Dedicated tenants. The wizard must support: uploading IdP metadata XML, fetching metadata by URL, pasting raw XML, and manual field entry as a fallback. Validation must include XML schema checks, certificate and fingerprint parsing, signature verification against the IdP cert, entityID and ACS/Logout URL canonicalization/whitelisting, assertion consumer URL host/port matching, clock skew tolerance, required attribute mappings, and clear, actionable error messages for admins. Persist a verifiable metadata snapshot with immutable audit trail entries and provide rotation workflows for IdP certificates. The UI should be designed for non-SRE admins but include an expandable advanced view for security engineers. The backend must emit structured audit logs for every metadata change, include diffing (old vs new metadata) in the audit entry, and wire events into the Console timeline and tenant-level incident dashboards.
acceptance_criteria: Wizard supports metadata upload, fetch-by-URL, paste-XML, and manual form fallback
Server validates metadata XML against SAML 2.0 schema and rejects malformed XML with user-facing error codes
Certificates are parsed and thumbprints stored; signature verification is attempted and failure surfaces guidance
ACS and SLO URLs are validated and normalized; cross-tenant host collisions are prevented
Metadata changes create immutable audit log entries with diff and actor identity (SSO admin), visible in Console
End-to-end test with Okta and a reference IdP (TestShib or simpleSAMLphp) proving SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows
RBAC: only users with the tenant SSO Admin role can complete the wizard and enable SSO
Telemetry emits events for metadata.fetch, metadata.upload, metadata.validate, metadata.enable, metadata.rotate
tasks: Design: wireframes for primary wizard flow + advanced security panel (DES-?)
Backend: metadata ingestion endpoint, XML schema validation, certificate extraction
Backend: signature verification path and clock-skew handling
Backend: persist metadata snapshot and compute/stash canonical thumbprint
Backend: audit-log entries with old/new diffs and actor metadata
API: endpoints for metadata fetch, validate-only, enable, disable, rotate
UI: form flow, validation error surfaces, guidance snippets for common IdPs (Okta, Azure AD, OneLogin)
QA: integration tests against reference IdPs and mocked expired certs/rotations
Security review and threat model update
Docs: admin guide and runbook for certificate rotation and troubleshooting
